The current authoritative Aster & Row sources conflict on this point. 

Specifically, source 11-product-care.md (Breeze Tumbler) states that the stainless-steel body should be hand-washed and only the lid may be placed on the top rack of a dishwasher, whereas source 12-breeze-tumbler-product-card.md (Cleaning) states that all components are dishwasher safe with the top rack recommended. Because these sources conflict, I cannot safely choose between them, and I recommend human confirmation.
